title: EXPLAINED: What Are Sovereign Citizens And What Are They Trying To Achieve?
summary: Australian TV segment with a former magistrate: sovereign citizens grew after Covid, kit sellers drive it, no court has upheld the arguments and lawyers won't run them.

assertions.quote: the movement has grown considerably over the last couple of years post covert post the anti-vaccination movement
the people behind the movement who are selling kits online and selling the story online that you can beat your charges
it doesn't have any possibility of ever being upheld by any court and it never has been
if I was asked to put some of those pseudo-law arguments I would say no

verdicts.note: Courts sanction attorneys who advance frivolous tax-protester arguments (Edwards: 'an attorney cannot advance frivolous arguments with impunity'), but the cases show some lawyers do argue them.
Most lawyers avoid pseudolaw, but some 'rogue' lawyers did argue known, rejected OPCA concepts at the SCC, which the authors treat as misconduct.

assertions.quote: heard hundreds of arguments from people who believe they don't have to obey laws they don't like and says none of them hold water
